channel: Living in Colorado Springs with Marquesa Hobbs
description:
I’m Marquesa Hobbs, a Top Colorado Springs & Monument Realtor®, luxury specialist, relocation expert, and trusted community voice regularly featured in local media. This channel is your insider's guide to Living and exploring the Pikes Peak area— neighborhood tours and luxury home showcases to real estate tips, market updates, and local lifestyle highlights.

Whether you’re moving to the area, exploring neighborhoods, staying on top of the market, or wanting an expert’s insight, you’ll find clear, honest information and local insight to make confident decisions.  Serving Flying Horse, Monument, Broadmoor, Peyton, Peregrine, Tri-Lakes, Wolf Ranch,  and surrounding areas.

Subscribe for real estate updates, homes for sale, local expertise, community news, market education, and expert tips for buying, selling and building in the Pikes Peak Area!
Let’s connect:
